steps.title: Ward ring, radius 8
lines: You're holding two Ward Lanterns, and every new ward has radius 8. Place one and look at the ring: it traces round, then closes.
Keep holding the other and walk round the edge. Is the circle closed in both, with no gap anywhere?
setup: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with paranormalcraft:ward_lantern 2

steps.title: Ward ring, radius 32
lines: The same at radius 32. Place a lantern, then look along the ring as it traces and closes.
Hold the other and walk out to the edge: only the part near you shows. Follow it a good way round. Any gap?
setup: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with paranormalcraft:ward_lantern 2

steps.title: Journal and tooltips: capital letters
lines: Read the Blessings and Bindings spread in the journal: do its sentences start with capital letters?
Then close it, open the Containment Unit, select a spirit, and hover Release and Bind. The same check.

steps.title: Agitated tint
lines: Goggles on, and an Agitated ghost hangs in front of you.
Does it read as angry at a glance: clearly red, pulsing slowly, with small dark-red motes rising off it?
setup: item replace entity @s armor.head with paranormalcraft:spectral_goggles

steps.title: Trap escape
lines: Look at the trap, set to 2%. In about 25 s it bursts. Take your goggles off for the burst if you want to check everyone sees it.
It should show itself red at the trap for about 2 s, drift away from you (no jump), then come round behind you and keep following.
setup: item replace entity @s armor.head with paranormalcraft:spectral_goggles

steps.title: Breach escape
lines: The unit is breaching, and a spirit gets out every 30 s. Stay close and watch the first one.
It should do the same: red at the unit for about 2 s, a visible drift away, then following, with no jump. Refuel from the chest when you've seen it.
setup: item replace entity @s armor.head with paranormalcraft:spectral_goggles

steps.title: "Something settles in"
lines: The ghost beside you is following you now. Turn subtitles on (Options, Accessibility) and walk toward the hut in the far corner.
When you get in range of the bed, do you hear one quiet creak from the hut, with the subtitle "Something settles in"?
